raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: robust-laplacian
  version: "1.1.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/robust_laplacian-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1db9eeb1a7aa340c3da902b125d2f58c7138feda206a72c2402dd25e702290d2

build:
  number: 2
  script:
    - python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - if: unix
      then: rm -rf "${SP_DIR}/lib"
    - if: win
      then: if exist "%SP_DIR%\\lib" rmdir /s /q "%SP_DIR%\\lib"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake <4
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pip
        - python
        - scikit-build-core
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - scikit-build-core
  run:
    - numpy
    - python
    - scipy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - robust_laplacian
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/nmwsharp/robust-laplacians-py
  repository: https://github.com/nmwsharp/robust-laplacians-py
  summary: Build high-quality Laplace matrices on meshes and point clouds in Python
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
